searched.title: Multi-Size Hotends Kit (store page)
searched.note: Parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, format legacy_html, route-derived productType "accessory"; the manifest says "hotend"). No specification table, no In the Box list, no weight or size, no document file list (productFileList null), no SKU codes. Option groups: Printer Model (6 values) × Combo (3 values), 18 variants. Feature block "Notice": "All hotends included in the kit are standard flow hotends." Three variant descriptions (the four-size combo for A2L, A1 Series and X1/P1 Series) carry only a gift promotion line; promotions are not stored. Description tables: (1) "Comparison of Different Nozzle Sizes" (usage prose per size): not a spec. (2) "Filament Compatibility" (39 filaments × 0.2 mm Stainless Steel / 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm Hardened Steel): its header gives nozzle.material per combo; a filament relation is written for the 11 rows marked √ in every column. 28 rows are mixed or "Not recommended" across the sizes every combo holds and get no relation. The combos hold two to four diameters, which the single-number nozzle.diameter key cannot hold; they stay in the Combo value text. The notes under the table are usage advice, not specs. No hotend count is printed: the Combo values name the sizes without a quantity and there is no In the Box list, so no contents.pieces row is written (a count of one hotend per named size would be an inference).

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The type panels give compatibility, maximum printing temperature, sizes and materials per hotend type (A Series 300 ℃, X1/P1 Series 320 ℃, H2 Series/P2S/X2D 350 ℃, Vortek Induction 350 ℃); none names this kit, so its temperatures are stored per Printer Model value as unverified. The layer-height table is general guidance per nozzle size and cannot be scoped to one combo; not stored. The High Flow sentence ("increases the maximum volume velocity by 62.5%") is about the High Flow nozzle; this kit is standard flow. No dimensions, weight, filament diameter, flow rate, electrical value or certification.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Linked from the store page ("Learn more about filament compatibility on Bambu Lab Wiki"). A general guide for every Bambu nozzle (0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8 mm and High Flow columns), so none of its rows is stored as a spec of this kit; it is used only to flag disagreements with this page's Filament Compatibility table on the relations written (PC and PC FR at 0.2 mm; the X2D auxiliary-hotend qualifier on ABS at 0.2 mm). Its nozzle temperatures are per filament, not the hotend maximum. It states no filament diameter and no flow rate.
